title: Legacy SWBOTB=2 time law and dry-continuation application semantics

source_semantics.sw2_1: qbot = SINAVE + SINAMP*cos((2*pi/365)*(legacy_t - SINMAX)); legacy_t is time relative to start of current calendar year and is evaluated at substep start
source_semantics.table_interpolation: legacy AFGEN linear interpolation with endpoint clamping
source_semantics.dry_guard: if bottom pressure head < -1.0e7 cm, effective selector is internal -2; otherwise effective selector is 2
source_semantics.dry_flux: effective -2 uses existing admitted free-drainage equation qbot=-K_bottom
source_semantics.reentry: the guard is re-evaluated from the next trial-start physical state; no independent persistent selector state is required

architecture_binding.owner: existing F-KT/F-MR transactional runtime remains sole state, retry, mass and commit owner
architecture_binding.time_law: typed immutable application control carried with forcing and resolved inside each physical advance using that substep's t0/t1
architecture_binding.calendar: runtime performs no Gregorian parsing; the application control receives an affine canonical-to-legacy-t1900 origin plus explicit consecutive calendar-year start boundaries for SW2=1
architecture_binding.dry_continuation: derived read-only from trial-start bottom pressure head; never stored as a second committed state
architecture_binding.solver: no residual, Jacobian, constitutive or free-drainage physics change
architecture_binding.parser: no general file-I/O/parser redesign; the typed adapter represents already decoded B1.11 SWBOTB=2 fields

qualification_required: exact SW2=1 phase/value oracle including year-boundary reset
exact SW2=2 interpolation and endpoint-clamp oracle
exact strict dry threshold and re-entry oracle
production bootstrap end-to-end reachability for time-varying SWBOTB=2
dynamic -2 route identity with directly configured admitted -2 reference
fail-closed invalid control and non-mode2 attachment
explicit_nonclaims: mode -2 as a normal user selector
new solver physics or numerical policy
exit: Canonical admission only if the complete typed legacy SWBOTB=2 time-law plus dry-continuation route passes owner and independent qualification without weakening inherited gates.

implementation_adjustment.trigger: Broad preservation CI compiles mod_fmr_serialized_reference_backend.f90 directly through established source lists; a new module dependency caused missing .mod failures in F-ROSS12 and F-GC44 despite the PPA-LOW02 owner and independent gates passing.
implementation_adjustment.disposition: Co-locate the immutable SWBOTB=2 application-control type and pure evaluation law with fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t in mod_fmr_serialized_reference_backend. Semantics and transaction ownership are unchanged; the separate adapter module is removed.
